    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    MOMENTUM is built on the conviction that sales fluency is a strategic capability — not a natural talent alone. Every module pairs business-English precision with persuasive judgment, commercial literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium sales leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern sales — from the foundations of prospecting and negotiation to AI-powered pipeline systems and virtual selling.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — objection handling, contract negotiations, account reviews, pipeline forecasts — written for international sales professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. MOMENTUM reflects his vision: sales fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and persuasive credibility.

    Designed for the sales representatives, account leads, and revenue leaders shaping how the world does business — MOMENTUM is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for turning genuine value into a closed deal.
